annotations.title: Get a drug or therapy programme

description: Use this when the user asks about one drug or therapy programme by its name or any code name (ubx1325, UBX-1325, BMS-986278). Returns its developers, partners and licensors, targets, mechanism, modality, every indication with its stage and source, lifespan evidence and news; its published research (papers a year and by kind, species reached, the newest papers and abstracts); designations (orphan, breakthrough, fast track, PRIME) by agency; an approved drug's patents and exclusivity; its development status (active, inactive, discontinued or approved) with reasons and stage by country; its next catalyst (a PDUFA date, an advisory committee, an expected readout, with how exactly its day is known); and its newest events from filings and regulators (topline results, complete response letters, clinical holds, programmes stopped). An account whose plan includes drug and therapy programmes reads every record in full; others read an outline, as the site's asset pages show it.

key.description: The asset's key or a code name.

name: get_asset
